summary_markdown:
The conversation covered several analytics calculations. Regarding facility sessions, it was confirmed that the total session count for a master facility should be the sum of sessions across all sensors. Furthermore, there were discussions about discrepancies in impression calculation and total traffic reporting.

Initially, [me] noted being tasked with an unclear request involving new impressions on staging. Later, [p1] reported speaking with someone (Esben) who advised against implementing new impressions, suggesting instead multiplying existing ones by 6, though this remains subject to further discussion. A major point of contention was the total traffic calculation method; Esben raised concerns that the calculations for 'Fields' and 'Ocean' needed to match, despite a previous decision/implementation mirroring the 'Fields' approach. The specific methodology—whether to count all sessions or consolidate them—was questioned due to performance concerns.
decisions: Master facility session count = sum of sessions across all sensors.
